plans.name: ultramodern-backport-00-scope-and-demo-split
plans.overview: Establish the boundary between UltraModern.js framework capabilities and the Tractor Store showcase so backports improve scaffolding/runtime behavior without turning the Modern.js fork into a demo repository.

todos.content: Audit the current UltraModern workspace generator and templates for Tractor Store specific content, demo-only assets, debug UI, and framework-level capabilities that should remain.
Define the vanilla UltraModern preset contract: easy to customize, i18n-ready, SSR-ready, Cloudflare-ready, CSS-isolated, vertical-oriented, and free of product-demo copy or assets.
Classify each discovered change as framework backport, generated-app baseline, native debug feature, or external demo repository work.
Write the extraction handoff for publishing the full Tractor Store showcase as a separate BleedingDev demo repository, including what must not be copied back into UltraModern.js.
Document that package publishing must run only through GitHub Actions trusted publishing and that framework pushes target the bleedingdev remote unless explicitly overridden.

plans.name: ultramodern-backport-01-css-i18n-routing
plans.overview: Backport the reusable SSR, i18n, and Tailwind isolation fixes into UltraModern generated apps without source-content tests or demo-specific markup.

todos.content: Audit generated shell and vertical apps for Tailwind v4 usage, prefix generation, content scanning, and remaining non-Tailwind CSS that is not strictly necessary.
Implement or tighten the Tailwind-native prefix contract so each generated app emits stable prefixed utility classes without regex-transforming arbitrary class names.
Remove any temporary shell-side font, size, or cascade patches that mask remote or vertical CSS problems instead of fixing isolation at the source.
Fix generated i18n message templates so copy is complete per locale, does not split literal phrases incorrectly, and can be customized from one obvious place.
Verify and fix generated SSR routing for localized paths, canonical metadata, alternate locale links, and no-JS full-page rendering.
Add targeted generator/runtime tests that validate class prefix emission, i18n template output, localized route config, and SSR markup shape without checking product-demo source content.

plans.name: ultramodern-backport-02-cloudflare-packages
plans.overview: Modernize generated Cloudflare deployment and package version defaults while preserving other deployment targets and keeping all publishing inside trusted GitHub Actions.

todos.content: Audit generated deploy scripts and Modern.js integration points to identify which Cloudflare steps are genuinely required and which are demo-specific or redundant wrappers.
Update generated workspace package defaults to the required Modern.js 11.5.x line and current UltraModern package source behavior.
Refactor Cloudflare deploy scaffolding so it uses Modern.js native build/deploy behavior as much as possible, with only necessary Worker-specific configuration and proof steps.
Validate that Cloudflare-specific environment variables, wrangler config generation, and deploy scripts do not break non-Cloudflare build or deploy targets.
Ensure package publication is documented and automated only through GitHub Actions trusted publishing, with no local npm publish workflow or manual package push path.
Run the package, generator, build, and scaffold verification gates required before opening the trusted-publishing release path.

plans.name: ultramodern-backport-03-native-boundaries
plans.overview: Turn team or vertical boundaries into a native UltraModern debug feature that generated apps can use without hand-written app UI or confusing page-level overlays.

todos.content: Design the native debug boundary API, including how shell, verticals, and route regions declare ownership without application-specific overlay code.
Remove or replace generated page-level boundary overlays that create confusing nested boxes or visible borders when the toggle is off.
Implement a persistent, accessible debug toggle whose state survives navigation, language changes, hydration, and full reloads.
Render boundaries only around meaningful vertical ownership regions, with labels and colors derived from framework metadata rather than demo-specific names.
Ensure the debug feature is opt-in for generated apps and cannot leak confusing UI into normal production flows unless explicitly enabled.
Validate the boundary feature with JavaScript enabled, JavaScript disabled, localized routes, and hydration so it does not change page content or layout.

plans.name: ultramodern-backport-04-fresh-scaffold-validation
plans.overview: Validate the backports from the point of view of a human scaffolding a brand-new repository, adding verticals, deploying, and testing SSR visually instead of relying on source-code content checks.

todos.content: Scaffold a completely new repository using the UltraModern preset and the documented human workflow, without copying the Tractor Store demo from the framework repository.
Add at least one new MicroVertical through the supported tooling and verify the generated vertical includes UI, route integration, BFF/API capability, i18n, and CSS isolation.
Build and run the generated app, disable JavaScript in the browser, and verify full styled page content renders without fallback warnings.
Test language switching across routes, reloads, and hydration, including debug boundary persistence and complete localized copy.
Test the native boundary debugger off and on with screenshots, confirming it stays fixed in the viewport and draws non-overlapping meaningful ownership regions.
Deploy the fresh scaffold to Cloudflare Workers or a preview equivalent, capture the deployed URL, and validate routing, SSR, assets, and styles from the deployed environment.
Capture browser screenshots for desktop and a narrower viewport using agent-browser or webwright, and record what was visually compared against expected behavior.
